study_type_evidence.quote: Three different doses of C-II-a peptide (0.2, 1 and 5 μmol/kg of body weight) were injected intravenously into Apoc2 mutant mice
Mouse plasma or human plasma samples (1: 250 in a final dilution) and/or 1.0 pmol/μL C-II-a and/or 0.008 units of LPL purified from bovine milk

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: Apoc2 mutant (9-bp deletion) mice backcrossed to C57BL/6 for 3 generations, founders from FVB/6NJ or B6CBAF1 oocytes; both sexes used (no gender differences observed); age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: Founder mice were crossed onto the C57BL/6 background for 3 generations and wild type siblings of the same generation were used as controls.
in_vivo_species.section: METHODS (Zinc Finger Nuclease mRNA Preparation and Microinjections of Mice)

ex_vivo_detail: LPL activity/lipolysis assay run on plasma taken out of the body: plasma from Apoc2 mutant mice and plasma from a human patient with apoC-II deficiency were diluted 1:250 and incubated with purified bovine-milk LPL with or without C-II-a; free-fatty-acid generation was the readout. The authors label this an "in vitro lipolysis assay", but it is plasma-based and is therefore classified ex vivo per the extraction protocol. The human plasma was an archival patient sample, not a dosed subject, so the study is not clinical.

agents.name: C-II-a (apoC-II mimetic peptide)
agents.sequence_source: The body never prints the C-II-a amino acid sequence; it is described only as "a novel bi-helical apoC-II mimetic peptide called C-II-a" whose first helix is based on 18A and whose second helix contains part of the apoC-II LPL activation domain (Introduction).
agents.dose: 0.2, 1 and 5 μmol/kg of body weight (IV dose-response); dose used for the half-life determination is not stated
agents.route: intravenous (retro-orbital sinus); also given intramuscularly (thigh) and subcutaneously (abdomen) in a separate experiment
agents.dose_route_quote: Three different doses of C-II-a peptide (0.2, 1 and 5 μmol/kg of body weight) were injected intravenously into Apoc2 mutant mice
agents.pk_quote: C-II-a was found to undergo mono-exponential decay with an estimated plasma half-life of approximately 1.33 ± 0.72 hours.

agents.name: 5A-R peptide (MALDI-TOF internal standard)
agents.sequence_source: METHODS (MALDI-TOF measurements of C-II-a): "the 5A-R peptide (DWLKAFYDRVAERLKEAFPDWAKAAYDRAAERAKEAA amino acid sequence, molecular weight=4330), which was used as an internal standard"
agents.dose: 1.1 μg spiked into the diluted plasma sample (not administered to animals)
agents.route: not applicable - added in vitro to thawed plasma as an assay internal standard
agents.dose_route_quote: diluted 100X with chilled 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) containing 1.1 μg of the 5A-R peptide

agents.name: heparin
agents.dose: 0.5 Unit/g body weight (100-165 μL in saline)
agents.dose_route_quote: 100-165 μL of heparin (Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Deerfield, IL; 0.5 Unit/g body weight) in saline was injected IV in mice that were heparinized.
agents.pk_quote: IV injection of heparin solution (0.5 Unit/g body weight) at 6.5 hours to displace any endothelial-bound C-II-a peptide

agents.name: saline (C-II-a dosing vehicle)
agents.dose: maximum injection volume 200 μL IV, 50 μL IM or SQ; no vehicle-only dosed arm is described
agents.route: intravenous, intramuscular or subcutaneous (as carrier for C-II-a and heparin)
agents.dose_route_quote: C-II-a peptide was dissolved in saline at a maximum concentration of 10 mg/mL

agents.name: lipoprotein lipase (LPL) purified from bovine milk
agents.chemical_identifier: LPL purified from bovine milk, Sigma-Aldrich
agents.dose: 0.008 units per well (ex vivo assay only; not administered to animals)
agents.route: not applicable - added to diluted plasma in a 96-well plate
agents.dose_route_quote: and/or 0.008 units of LPL purified from bovine milk (Sigma-Aldrich) were added into wells of a 96-well plate

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 8A (and Fig. 8B for the heparin-challenge decay curve)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: we measured the half-life of C-II-a by MALDI-TOF MS (Fig. 8A)
concentration_time_figure.note: Figure legends were not rendered into this PDF text, so the quote is the Results sentence that identifies the panel. Fig. 8A plots the mono-exponential decay of plasma C-II-a over time after injection; Fig. 8B repeats it with an IV heparin challenge at 6.5 h. Signal is a MALDI peak-area ratio to the 5A-R internal standard normalised to the 15-minute time point, i.e. relative rather than absolute plasma concentration.

bioanalytical_method: MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry (Bruker Autoflex III, linear positive mode) of ZipTip C18-purified plasma, quantified as peak-area ratio to a spiked 5A-R internal standard; plasma lipids by enzymatic kits and lipoprotein proteome by LC-MS/MS
bioanalytical_quote: Peak areas were used to determine the ratio of sample to 5A-R and each mouse was normalized to the 15’ time point.
notes: Abstract was fenced and was not used; the half-life 1.33 +/- 0.72 h is independently stated twice in the body (Results, C-II-a Enhances in vivo Lipolysis; and Discussion), so it is a body-sourced value. NO Cmax, tmax or AUC is reported anywhere in the body - the MALDI readout is a peak-area ratio normalised to the 15-minute time point, so absolute plasma concentrations were never produced and a Cmax could not exist in this design. NO absorption half-life and no rate constant are reported. half_life_phase is recorded as "unspecified" because the paper says only "mono-exponential decay" and never names an elimination, distribution or terminal phase; half_life_elimination is therefore left "not reported" rather than inferred. The dose used for the half-life experiment is not stated in the body; the body states only that 0.2, 1 and 5 umol/kg were given IV in the dose-response study, and the peplife2 metadata value of 1.0 umol/kg was NOT used as it is database metadata. group_n for the PK experiment is not reported; the only n values in the body are for pooled lipoprotein work ("pooled fasting plasma samples (10 uL, n=3 mice per group)" and "Pooled plasma (0.25 mL; n = 3-5 mice per group)"), which are not the half-life arm. The C-II-a sequence is not printed in the body, so sequence is "not reported" despite a sequence appearing in the peplife2 metadata header, which the protocol forbids using. Wild-type and heterozygous littermates are genotype comparison groups rather than administered substances and so are not listed as agents. Figure legends were not captured by the PDF text extraction, so figure identification relies on in-text panel citations.
